title: Blasphemy from a mixed heart
english: The sons of an Israelite woman and an Egyptian, who cursed the name. The history is open; the inner sense labors. From a mixed heart blasphemy is born.
translator_notes: True OET: no ANF; do not copy Barkley FOTC 83.
orientation: Origen is introducing the story of the blasphemer in Leviticus 24, whose mixed parentage he reads as a figure of a divided soul.

title: Blasphemy expelled from the camp
english: They lead him beyond the camp. Blasphemy is expelled. The church shares nothing with darkness.
translator_notes: True OET: no ANF; do not copy Barkley FOTC 83.
orientation: Origen is interpreting the punishment of the blasphemer from Leviticus 24, applying it spiritually to the church's separation from darkness.

title: The first witnesses cast the stone
english: The hand of the witnesses is first; all the people will stone him. A weighty testimony. Truth is not idle.
translator_notes: True OET: no ANF; do not copy Barkley FOTC 83.
orientation: Origen is commenting on the expulsion of the blasphemer from the camp, now describing the execution by stoning and the role of the witnesses.

title: The law's severity and the gospel's mercy
english: The law said, “Eye for eye” (Leviticus 24:20); the gospel offers the cheek (Matthew 5:39). The letter is severe; the spirit is merciful. Amen.
translator_notes: True OET: no ANF; do not copy Barkley FOTC 83.
orientation: Origen is contrasting the literal severity of the Levitical law with the merciful spiritual sense revealed in the gospel.
